This event matters as a key early-season opportunity for players to build momentum and FedExCup points.
preview.modelExplainer: The model prioritizes SG Total (30%) and SG Approach (20%) to capture overall performance and approach play, while SG Around-the-Green (10%) and SG Putting (15%) account for short-game and green-side execution. sections.heading: Tournament Overview
sections.body: The World Wide Technology Championship features a 116-player field at El Cardonal at Diamante. The model assigns SG Total 30 percent weight, SG Approach 20 percent, SG OTT 15 percent, and SG Putting 15 percent. No weather or tee-time data are available.

sections.heading: Course Fit
sections.body: El Cardonal weights approach play and total strokes gained most heavily. Yellamaraju posts 474 SG Approach and 34 SG Total. Gerard records 712 SG Approach and 94 SG Total. Lipsky shows 192 SG Approach and 89 SG Total.

sections.heading: Recent Form and Model Strength
sections.body: Yellamaraju leads the tournament model at rank 1 with 34 SG Total and ranks 19th in power rank. Gerard sits second in the model at 94 SG Total and 31st in power rank. Lipsky ranks third in the model at 89 SG Total and 24th in power rank.

sections.heading: Post-Open Workload and FedExCup Context
sections.body: All three players recorded zero tracked rounds in the major swing workload category. Yellamaraju sits at FedExCup #58 in the bubble 51-80 tier. Gerard holds FedExCup #17 in the safe top-50 tier. Lipsky is FedExCup #85 in the chasing 81-plus tier.

sections.heading: Crossover Research Angles
sections.body: Each player skipped the Scottish Open and carries a model rank well ahead of power rank. Yellamaraju leads the model at rank 1 versus power rank 19. Gerard ranks second in the model versus power rank 31. Lipsky ranks third in the model versus power rank 24.

sections.heading: Outright Targets
sections.body: Yellamaraju and Gerard are the two outright targets. Yellamaraju leads the model at rank 1 with 34 SG Total. Gerard ranks second in the model at 94 SG Total and holds FedExCup position #17.
